name: SSH Computers
description: Run sessions on a Mac, Linux server, or VM you can reach over SSH.

provider.label: SSH host
provider.description: A computer you can already reach with `ssh`. Recursive installs and starts its runner there.

schema.label: Host
schema.description: user@hostname or an alias from ~/.ssh/config. Key-based login must already work.

schema.label: Identity file
schema.description: Optional path to a private key.
